NOT accommodation in the usual per-property sense - SkySafari is Elewana Collection's fixed-departure, multi-day, all-inclusive PRIVATE-AIRCRAFT flying safari PACKAGE product (fixed itinerary bundling several Elewana camps + private air transfers + Nairobi hotel night). Included in this extraction slice because the source folder is literally named SKYSAFARIS under KENYA/ACCOMODATION. Only the KENYA-specific packages (8 Day and 10 Day) were extracted - Tanzania 8/10 Day and combined East Africa 13 Day packages in the same document are out of scope (Tanzania excluded per this project's standing rules) and were not extracted. A second document, '35-SkySafari-Full-Buyout-Rates-2026.pdf', contains a private full-group-charter/buyout variant with per-group-size Rack/Nett pricing tables - NOT extracted this pass (complex multi-column group-size tables across 5 itinerary types), flagged as a gap for a future extraction if a full-buyout SkySafari quote is ever needed.
